title: Map-based localisation: from a photo to latitude and longitude
summary: Where on the map was this photo taken? Global retrieval with embeddings — DINOv2, a pretrained network, against your own small network trained on views you make from the map, both measured against honest baselines — then local feature matching with OpenCV for the exact latitude and longitude, your rule for when retrieval is worth it, an error budget and the four numbers of an honest evaluation.
